final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.invoice_number IS NOT NULL THEN o.order_id END) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) AS overall_average FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoiced_order_count) AS average_invoiced_order_count, AVG(g.invoiced_order_count - o.overall_average) AS average_excess FROM gender_counts AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE g.invoiced_order_count > o.overall_average
